title: AC1021 truetype strict whole-source output and DXF readback

followUp: The group-370 replay boundary below was resolved in p4-ac1021-truetype-layerstate-dxf-group370-replay-2026-11-07.json. This receipt remains the evidence for strict whole-source output and first fresh import readback.
scope: Verify strict AC1021 whole-source ASCII/Binary DXF output and fresh whole-file typed import readback for the existing truetype drawing; validate its rooted LayerStates XRECORD's group-330/331 table targets; test atomic unresolved-target refusal and same-adapter correction/retry.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing; producer and author are not independently authenticated. The source and generated derivatives remain outside the repository.

sourceGraph.priorEvidence: The source-bound fields and target identities were independently cross-checked against LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON and ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.104 in p4-ac1021-truetype-layerstates-view-xrecord-selected-output-2026-11-07.json.

implementation.change: Extension-graph validation now resolves XRECORD group-330 targets when they uniquely identify emitted LAYER rows and group-331 targets when they uniquely identify emitted LTYPE rows. This permits a valid emitted DXF to pass fresh full-file import without a DWG-only LayerStates receipt. Generated admission controls require present correctly typed targets and reject a missing target. Added a source-bound physical selector that exercises RequireComplete output, fresh complete typed readback, destination preservation and same-adapter retry in both encodings.

generatedAdmission.result: PASS; group-330 to a present LAYER and group-331 to a present LTYPE are admitted; a dangling target is rejected. Existing rooted GROUP reference and resource-limit refusal/retry cases pass.

physicalWholeSource.result: PASS in ASCII and Binary using RequireComplete. Each run verifies 173 source frames, FinalizedComplete coverage, 173 Published frames, zero parse failures and zero integrity rows. The full DXF freshly imports; all XRECORDs, LAYERs and LTYPEs are present; the exact XRECORD owner, four group-330 LAYER targets, four group-331 LTYPE targets and four group-370 values are preserved. An unresolved handle refuses without replacing a destination sentinel; correcting it and retrying the same adapter succeeds.

selectedRegression.result: PASS in ASCII and Binary; the existing selected VIEWPORT profile still qualifies 53/53 source callbacks and preserves its readback/refusal/retry controls.

DXFOriginResaveBoundary.result: At this slice, the emitted DXF imported through full graph preparation, including group-330/331 references, then XRECORD output refused group-370 because it lacked the DWG LayerStates receipt. This boundary was closed by the source-bound DXF replay follow-up linked above; keep that route limited to its exact profile.

limits: This qualifies one unauthenticated local AC1021 source and does not promote producer-wide, native application, or DWG/DXF support claims.
The initial DXF-origin group-370 replay gap in this receipt is resolved only by the exact profile in the linked follow-up. Do not generalize that route to other XRECORDs, payloads, or versions.
